products.title: Linen Co-ord — Slate
products.description: The same signature silhouette in a classic slate wash. Our linen co-ord set in its most versatile colourway — pairs beautifully with gold accessories and bare skin.

products.title: Mono Print Peplum Two-Piece
products.description: A fitted peplum top in a bold monochrome swirl print, paired with a matching flared midi skirt. Puff sleeves and a defined waist make this a statement two-piece that still moves easily through a full day out.

products.title: Floral Shirt & Shorts Two-Piece
products.description: An oversized floral shirt in warm olive and cream tones, paired with tailored olive shorts. Relaxed through the shoulders, structured at the waist — easy to dress up or down.

products.title: Red Beaded Off-Shoulder Gown
products.description: The showpiece. An off-shoulder beaded bodice flows into a ruched mermaid skirt with a dramatic cathedral train. Hand-embellished with over 800 micro-beads. Made to order in 10–14 days.

products.title: Pinstripe Wide-Leg Linen Set
products.description: The power set. A relaxed pinstripe shirt-jacket paired with matching high-waist wide-leg trousers in a rich burgundy linen blend. Unstructured, confident, unmistakably PHERAN.

products.title: Brown Relaxed Shirt & Trouser Set
products.description: A relaxed, oversized shirt in a rich chocolate brown, paired with matching wide-leg trousers. Quietly confident tailoring built from breathable linen blend — as at home in the office as it is at a weekend brunch.

products.title: Splash Adire Set
products.description: Made with quality adire crepe suitable for any weather and outing. Fabric is light and very durable
